Qatar's Stranded LNG Fleet Is Starting to Move Again We don't just track crossings. The speed of Qatar-controlled LNG tankers tells the whole story. With no alternative export route, Qatar's tankers had nowhere to go. Dozens sat moored off the coast of India for months. The recovery won't be quick — Iranian strikes took out ~12.8 MTPA of Ras Laffan capacity (3-5 year repair timeline), and a restart explosion at the Barzan facility on June 22 killed 13 workers.
